edges.effect_quant: Across randomized implementation-intention studies, effects tend to be modest but favorable: a physical-activity meta-analysis found reinforced implementation-intention strategies improved behavior with a pooled standardized effect of 0.25 (95% CI 0.05 to 0.45), and an alcohol-focused meta-analysis found weekly consumption fell by d = -0.14 (95% CI -0.24 to -0.03).
edges.population: adults attempting to complete planned health behaviors such as walking, exercise, smoking cessation, or alcohol reduction
edges.mechanism: Implementation intentions translate a vague goal into a cue-linked action plan, usually in an if-then or when-then format. That makes the intended behavior easier to trigger in real-world contexts and reduces the need for repeated deliberation at the moment of action.
edges.summary: The evidence suggests implementation intentions can modestly improve follow-through on targeted health behaviors. Benefits appear most reliable when plans are concrete, tied to routine cues, and reinforced over time rather than written once and forgotten.
edges.caveats: This edge spans several kinds of behavior change, so the apparent benefit is not equally strong in every setting. Effects are usually small, and some gains may reflect better planning around one behavior domain, such as walking or smoking, more than a broad increase in adherence to all intended behaviors.

evidence.citation: Robinson SA et al 2019 Psychol Health
evidence.notes: Time for change: using implementation intentions to promote physical activity in a randomised pilot trial. Personalized schedules and maps increased steps and moderate-to-vigorous physical activity versus control.

evidence.citation: Mcgrath E et al 2020 Ann Behav Med
evidence.notes: Evidence That Implementation Intentions Enhance Cognitive Training and Reduce Alcohol Consumption in Heavy Drinkers: A Randomized Trial. Adding implementation intentions reduced alcohol consumption by 6.9 units per week at follow-up.

evidence.citation: Armitage CJ et al 2016 Health Psychol
evidence.notes: Evidence that implementation intentions can overcome the effects of smoking habits.

new_entities.name: Implementation intentions
new_entities.description: Structured plans that specify when, where, and how a person will perform a target behavior in response to a cue.
